name: Stickman Cute
description: 귀여운 스틱맨 스타일. 깔끔하고 친근한 손그림 느낌의 교육/설명 콘텐츠에 적합
scene_style_description: Clean and charming hand-drawn stick figure illustration style with friendly, symmetric characters and positive, lighthearted mood.

style.art_style: Clean and charming hand-drawn stick figure illustration

linework.outline: Smooth, consistent black ink lines. Organic but tidy, resembling a high-quality felt-tip pen drawing
linework.variation: Minimal wobble, clean strokes without messy scribbles or scratchiness to ensure a polished look

style.shapes: Cute and approachable proportions. Large perfectly round head, simple stick body with slightly rounded hands and feet. Soft curves rather than sharp angles
style.color_palette: Crisp black outlines on a clean white background. (Flexible for adding bright, soft, and friendly flat colors if needed)
style.shading: Flat and clean, smooth white paper feel, removing heavy crumpled textures for a crisp and modern look
style.character_design: Friendly, symmetric, and expressive. Big circular eyes and a wide, happy smile. Features are designed to look appealing and cute (호감형), avoiding the grotesque or manic look of typical rage comics
style.mood_and_tone: Positive, energetic, lighthearted, and playful. A doodle style that feels warm and inviting
style.background: Pure white or very subtle minimal background

technical.resolution: High contrast, crisp digital line art
technical.scene_style: Clean and charming hand-drawn stick figure illustration. Characters have large round heads and simple stick bodies. Positive, lighthearted doodle style.
